findings.text: a held review's display-only command names the saturated lane: _composed_review_lane returns ['--local'] whenever _review_lane_candidates yields nothing, which is exactly the awaiting-lane hold this change introduces, so the printed retypeable command sends a review to the lane the executed path has withheld; no test pins it and it is disclosed as follow-on (2) in the run's manifest.

item_verdicts.diff: read at 4027b1c368. The production change is +151/-12 in reckon/crew/recovery.py: it adds the lane_document import, the LANE_READING_FRESH_SECONDS=45 bound, _ordered_review_lanes (the former body of _review_lane_candidates, renamed), _current_lane_reading, _lane_over_ceiling, _review_lane_plan, and a thin _review_lane_candidates wrapper; it threads owning_backend into _no_lane_reason and into both dispatch call sites. The test file adds 346 lines across seven cases. _review_lane_candidates is called from three production sites (recovery.py:545 _composed_review_lane, :1569 dispatch_review_for_run, :2120 dispatch_repair_for_run).
item_verdicts.done_when: section 4b's done-when asks dispatch_review_for_run to select its backend rather than assert it, asserted by a test offering a lane whose running meets or exceeds its concurrent_requests (dispatch goes elsewhere or records awaiting-lane) and by a test offering a healthy lane (the local one still preferred). Both assertions are delivered: tests/test_a_review_waits_for_a_saturated_lane.py::test_a_saturated_local_lane_holds_the_review and ::test_a_saturated_metered_lane_is_passed_over cover the first, ::test_a_healthy_local_lane_still_carries_the_review the second. The base reproduction at 1c20ca680 returns ['alpha','beta'] for the saturated local lane while head returns [] with the hold reason naming alpha at 30 running against its 22 ceiling. The done-when's third clause (a review abandoning inside its first minute is not recomposed onto the same backend) is the earlier selection change recorded as 7cb989af, not this node's work; this node adds the headroom reading the section names as its second consequence.
item_verdicts.goal: the dispatched goal was to read each candidate review lane's own published reading before composing a review onto it, so the reflex honours the destination lane's headroom instead of pinning work to a lane already over its own limit. reckon/crew/recovery.py:_review_lane_candidates now defers to _review_lane_plan, which walks the preference ordering, reads each candidate's own declared lane_document through _current_lane_reading/_lane_over_ceiling, and passes over a lane its own document reports running at or above its concurrent_requests ceiling. A saturated local lane with no eligible candidate ahead of it yields no lane and the caller records awaiting-lane naming the lane and both figures; a saturated metered lane is passed over and the next candidate follows. A reading that is stale, absent, malformed, or the drained shape a lane publishes when its pool empties leaves the ordering unchanged, so a missing measurement never holds work.
item_verdicts.manifest: commits, changed_paths, tests, test_logs, baseline_suite/after_suite and negative_control_log match the tree, and the worktree is clean at 4027b1c368. The after_suite revision (51a199df2) is the code commit while worktree HEAD is the evidence commit 4027b1c368, which adds only the landing HTML, so the gate measured the code under review. Re-running both arms here reproduced the recorded numbers exactly: head 46 passed EXIT=0 and base 39 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node declares reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_a_review_waits_for_a_saturated_lane.py and docs/evidence/fragments/scoring-should-stop-a-promotion/a-review-waits-for-a-saturated-lane.html. Its two commits (51a199df2, 4027b1c368) touch exactly those three paths and nothing else; no changed path lies outside the grant.

justifications.durability: the new tests are isolated (tmp_path, a monkeypatched RECKON_HOME, a dedicated basetemp per arm) and cover the whole reading matrix — healthy, drained, stale, absent, saturated metered, saturated local hold, healthy local compose — and the declared mutation reddens the two saturation cases. The reflex path is gated by the watch admission rather than the suite-wide waiver, so the refusal is exercised rather than let through. Deducted two because the held case's display-only command is not asserted: _composed_review_lane still returns ['--local'] for an empty ordering, so a held review prints a lane the executed path has just withheld, and no test pins that divergence.
justifications.evidence: every recorded measurement was reproduced independently here. The base reproduction at 1c20ca680 returns ['alpha','beta'] with the saturated lane leading and the head returns [] with the hold reason naming alpha 30 running / 22 ceiling, and the instrument's positive control shows the reader seeing running=30, concurrent_requests=22, stale=False, so the empty result is about the selection rather than a blind reader. Both gate arms re-ran to the same numbers the manifest records (head 46 passed EXIT=0, base 39 passed EXIT=0), and the declared mutation (make _review_lane_candidates ignore the lane document) reddens exactly the two saturation assertions, 2 failed / 5 passed EXIT=1, matching logs/negative-control-ignore-lane-document.log. Deducted one because the reviewed manifest's base arm ran in a scratch tree that was deleted, so that arm's provenance rests on its log header rather than a path re-runnable from the run directory alone.
justifications.fit: the change is cohesive and reuses what exists: it reuses reckon/crew/lane_document.read_lane_document_file rather than re-parsing the document, keeps _review_lane_candidates as a thin wrapper so its three callers are unchanged in shape, and expresses the hold as (eligible lanes, withheld lane with its counts) rather than a second selection. Deducted two because _review_lane_plan is invoked twice along the hold path (_review_lane_candidates and then _no_lane_reason), reading every candidate's document a second time, and because _composed_review_lane now performs file I/O for a printed artifact whose lane can disagree with the executed selection.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the headroom-reading half of section 4b's done-when lands and is reachable through the reflex's own dispatch_review_for_run: a saturated local lane with no eligible candidate ahead withholds the review as awaiting-lane naming the lane and both figures (exercised end to end by test_a_saturated_local_lane_holds_the_review, which also asserts no review run is created), a healthy local lane still leads a real compose (test_a_healthy_local_lane_still_carries_the_review), and a saturated metered lane is passed over. Deducted two because the go-elsewhere arm is asserted only against the _review_lane_candidates helper (test_a_saturated_metered_lane_is_passed_over), not through dispatch_review_for_run composing onto the next candidate, so the dispatch-level fall-back path for a non-local saturated lane carries no end-to-end assertion.
justifications.scope_discipline: three changed paths, all inside the run's declared grant; both commits carry a conventional subject and a body stating what changed and why, with no AI trailer and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in subject, body, filenames, symbols or comments (the new symbols are _ordered_review_lanes, _current_lane_reading, _lane_over_ceiling, _review_lane_plan, LANE_READING_FRESH_SECONDS). Ruff adds no finding: recovery.py reports the same six pre-existing findings at base and at head and the new test file is clean. No shared plan state, project index or peer path is touched.
